title: Descent from Olmo: 600m down with the family, walking
terrain: Rifugio Olmo (1819m) to the trailhead, ~600m D-, walking, poles

steps.target: Z1 walking descent, poles, short steps, 95-125 bpm

coachNotes:
EXECUTION: walk the whole 600m down from Olmo with the family. Poles, short steps, cadence high, no running on any of it however easy it feels. Second descent in 24h and the last eccentric load before the race.
GYM: hip abductor block, light.
FUEL: water, plus one bottle of Isocarb if the walk runs long. No test today.
STOP RULE: quad soreness from Saturday is expected and fine. Lateral knee pain here is not, and it changes race-day descent strategy rather than the training - report it the same day.
WHY: separating Saturday's running descent from this one by a full night is the reason the weekend clears the ITB guardrails at all. Taper starts here; nothing between today and 12 September adds fitness.
